meta.title: Vendor Form Sections (vendor.form.sections) = default plus Qualifications, References
gaps: Set the tenant setting vendor.form.sections to Basic Info, Banking, Documents, Tax, Qualifications, and References.
Import vendors directly from the enterprise's existing VMS/VRP as an Implementation Partner.
Observe and verify that all six configured sections are visible and required on the vendor onboarding form.
